subject: general
question: Which of the following countries hosted the IBA Women’s World Boxing Championships for the third time in March 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** hosted the IBA Women's World Boxing Championships for the third time in March 2023.
 
• This championship is one of the most prestigious events in women's boxing, featuring top female boxers from around the world.
 
• The event was held in New Delhi, the capital city of India.
 
• Hosting the championship multiple times demonstrates India's growing influence and commitment to promoting women's sports, particularly boxing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The IBA Women's World Boxing Championships is organized by the International Boxing Association (IBA).
 
• The first Women's World Boxing Championships was held in Scranton, USA, in 2001.
 
• India previously hosted the championships in 2006 and 2018.
 
• Mary Kom, a renowned Indian boxer, has won multiple gold medals in this championship, bringing significant attention to women's boxing in India.
 
• India's successful hosting of international sporting events boosts its reputation as a capable and enthusiastic host nation.
